settings.mining.title: Mining Mode
settings.mining.toSweep: Current: Wall Excavation  →  Switch to Tunnel Sweep
settings.mining.toWall: Current: Tunnel Sweep  →  Switch to Wall Excavation
settings.mining.wall: Wall Excavation: Strip layered rock with pickaxe and charges. Uncover every tile of a deposit to claim it.
settings.mining.sweep: Tunnel Sweep: Dig adjacent tiles one by one and use floor numbers to pinpoint nearby enemy nests.
settings.mining.note: Takes effect from the next expedition. (Practice always uses Wall Excavation.)

guide.1.1: Start the first wave, then deploy cards from your hand.
guide.1.2: Place buildings on round pads and units on road slots.
guide.1.3: Select the same card again to cancel placement.
guide.1.4: Select a deployed building or unit to view stats or withdraw it.
guide.2.1: You get 5 base digs during each preparation phase.
guide.2.2: Select a tile to send the miner to excavate it.
guide.2.3: Floor numbers show how many nests lie in the surrounding 8 tiles.
guide.2.4: Use your free scan to inspect a suspicious frontier tile first.
guide.3.1: Spend iron, copper, and crystal to craft tools and combat gear.
guide.3.2: Spend gold to expand squad slots or recruit new cards.
guide.3.3: Surviving units, remaining HP, and buildings carry over between waves.
guide.3.4: Protect the base through the final wave to secure the zone.
guide.wall.1: 5 base digs per prep phase. Pickaxe uses 1 dig; Blast uses 2.
guide.wall.2: Strip the rock wall layer by layer from the top row down.
guide.wall.3: Uncover every tile of an ore vein or relic to collect it.
guide.wall.4: Blasting a nest triggers extra enemies in the next wave.
